title: fix: error on `composes:` references to undefined classes
author: Kenzo-Wada
summary: Adds PrinterErrorKind::MissingComposesName, an error after printing when a `composes:` name (same file, or a cross-file reference resolved by the bundler) has no export. Today such references silently produce a hashed class name with no styles. That fits the strict-by-default philosophy, but it will break builds that pass today, so release notes should call it out.
evidence: #1215: `composes: historychevron` (wrong case) silently exports a dangling name. The PR rewrites an existing bundler test that expected the silent behavior (`composes: x from './b.css'` where b.css has no `.x`), so the expectation change is intentional. Review points: is a class whose only rule is removed by minify (e.g. empty `.b{}`) still in exports, or would that now error falsely; should errorRecovery turn this into a warning, as with other strict errors; a new public enum variant (PrinterErrorKind) and a new JS error message; the base is df63db2 (April), and css_modules.rs Pattern changed since, so it probably needs a rebase. No comments from anyone.
